answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks by forcing each new identity to lock a bond equal to the square of the operator’s detected cluster size on the attestation graph. The crystal of reputation forms only after the identity tends a unique plot in the shared verification garden%3B each additional fake must therefore scale a steeper ledge of locked capital that cannot be amortized. Coordinated clusters trigger full-slash of all bonds upon peer detection%2C so an attacker running n aliases pays O(n²) capital that stays locked until the next independent audit.
